Maria: Hey infra team — new customer onboarding: they want three orgs (prod/stage/dev) across AWS us-east-1, GCP us-central1, and Azure eastus2. Need a quick checklist for: GPU quota requests (A100/V100), VPC egress limits, public IP/EIP reservations, IAM roles, billing/CC tags, and SLA awareness. Can someone sketch the exact items I should request from cloud support and what tags we must enforce?

Sam: +1. Do we have a template for cross-cloud quota escalation?

Li: I have a template for AWS/GCP but not for Azure. Quick answers:
- AWS: request service limit increases for p4/p3/p2 (or equivalent), ENI/sec if heavy pods, EIP quota if you need static IPs, and EC2 instance soft limit for GPUs. Also ask for spot instance advice if they want lower cost.
- GCP: quotas for accelerators (A100/V100), regional GPU availability, CPUs & GPUs per project, and external IPs. Ask for quota at the project and region level.
- Azure: request GPU quota per subscription (NC/ND/NDv4 families), regional capacity checks, and public IP prefix reservations.

Noah: Include networking specifics: NAT gateway throughput & SNAT port quotas, Cloud Router (GCP) or ExpressRoute configuration windows, and egress cost estimates for heavy model downloads. Also ask about cross-region peering limits if they replicate weighty model snapshots.

Maria: Great — actionable ask list would be super. Also need machine images and a list of required IAM roles so SRE can automate terraform enrollments.

Sam: Here is the minimal request body we send to support (pasteable):

```
Customer: ACME AI (Redwood POC)
Cloud: AWS
Region: us-east-1
Project/Account: acct-ACME-prod
Requested resources:\n  - p4d.24xlarge: increase from 0 to 8 (on-demand)
  - p3.8xlarge: increase from 0 to 12 (spot)
  - Elastic IPs: 10
  - ENI/sec: 5000
Reason: GPU-backed inference fleet for LLM serving, expected 5k TPS during warm periods. Please advise on stock and potential backorder windows.
```

Adapt for GCP and Azure with accelerator names and quota units.

Li: For tags, enforce the following key/value pairs at account/project creation: `cost-center`, `team`, `env`, `project-id`, `owner_email`, `data-classification`. For GCP use labels, AWS use tags, Azure use tags. Make `cost-center` and `owner_email` mandatory in the SCP/policy.

InfraTool Bot: FYI: We have a policy doc at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cloud-quota-requests that covers the steps and escalation emails.

Maria: Can someone confirm billing setup: consolidated billing vs. separate for security/compliance? Customer requires separate billing per org for chargeback.

Noah: If they need per-org billing, set up separate master accounts (AWS org) and link paid accounts but avoid cross-account roles that grant excessive privileges. For GCP, set up separate billing accounts and link projects. Make sure to validate IAM Billing Account User role on the payment admin.

Sam: Also add automation hooks: create a Terraform repo template that includes preapproved quota requests (as issues) and an onboarding GH action that opens support tickets + tags request with ticket ID. Minimal IAM roles for bootstrap: `infra-admin` (limited), `read-only-billing`, `service-deployer` (assume-role for runtime nodes).

Li: Quick IAM nit: avoid giving `Organization Admin` to the SRE onboarding user. Use `IAM Conditions` on roles where possible and require MFA.

Maria: Any advice on soft vs. hard quotas for GPUs? Customer worried about sudden capacity no-gos during US holidays.

Noah: Ask support for quota increases with a note: "committed capacity window" and request confirmation of regional capacity availability. If they can provide a capacity reservation (AWS capacity reservations / GCP private pool / Azure capacity reservation) that should be requested in parallel. Add fallback model variants (quantized) in our rollout plan.

Sam: TODOs — I can draft the three support request emails and the Terraform template tonight. Who can review?

Li: I can review AWS & GCP requests. @Noah take Azure.

Maria: Thanks. Please include estimated lead times in the emails and a request for any backorder/fulfillment SLAs. I'll tag sales for procurement approval and legal for any extra contract terms.

InfraTool Bot: Created checklist ticket in Jira: INFRA-4768 onboarding-acme-gpu-quota. Link: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/INFRA-4768

Maria: Perfect. Let's sync tomorrow at 10am PT to finalize the requests. :thumbsup:

Sam: ack

Li: ack :white_check_mark:

Noah: ack :rocket:

Oncall Bot: Reminder: when you open support requests, include the exact project numbers and attach a CSV with estimated monthly GPU hours — helps prioritize quota fill.

Maria: noted, will prepare CSV and the terraform skeleton. Thanks everyone!
